content: {"phoneNote":"The tall sticky header with a full-width red button plus two stacked text links in the hero means three call/write actions on the first screen, while the hero links are small and underweight.","desktopNote":"Every section runs only in the left half of the 1280px canvas, leaving a dead right column below the headline, beside prices and beside the location text as if photos were missing.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":3,"spacing":3,"clutter":2,"distinctiveness":3},"desktop":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":2,"spacing":2,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":3},"fixes":["Fill the empty right half on desktop: place a portrait of Pia or a notebook/formula detail beside the hero text and beside 'Kje poteka', or narrow the container to a readable single column.","Keep one red 'Pokličite' in the header and one real button in the hero; drop the duplicate 'Pokličite me' and small 'Pišite mi' links, and give the dark CTA band a proper button.","Shrink the giant footer wordmark and remove the second 'Inštrukcije Pia' line beneath it; also slim the phone header so headline and intro start higher on the first screen."],"blockers":["Footer (both viewports): the name 'Inštrukcije Pia' appears as a giant wordmark and again as a bold line directly beneath it, a repeated block.","Desktop full page: the sticky header renders over the first line of the headline ('Matematika in fizika, ki') in the capture, hiding it."]}
